question: Which part of an eval decides whether a run passed?

options.text: A model grader that reads the reply and not the files.
options.why: Right. A judge that reads the claim can pass the claim, whatever the files hold.

options.text: A code grader that runs the tape's checks.
options.why: Wrong. The checks read the files, so the code grader cannot be talked into a pass.

options.text: A human grader who reads the whole run.
options.why: Tempting. A person can be wrong too, but reading the whole run is not reading the claim alone.
